Cisco ASR-920-24SZ-M Router | High-Performance Metro Ethernet Router

Scalable, Reliable & High-Speed Metro Routing

The Cisco ASR-920-24SZ-M is a compact, carrier-grade Metro Ethernet router  designed to deliver exceptional performance, scalability, and flexibility for service providers, enterprises, and metro networks. With 24 x 1GE SFP ports, 4 x 10G SFP+ ports, and a full 10G license, this router ensures high-speed data transmission and seamless network management.


High-Speed Throughput – 64 Gbps for ultra-fast data processing

Carrier-Grade Resilience – Redundant Dual DC (Hot Swap) Power Supplies

Compact 1U Rackmount Design – Optimized for space efficiency

Full 10G License Included – Advanced Metro IP Access with no extra cost

USB Console, Management & Auxiliary Console Ports – Simplified control & monitoring

Optimized Cooling – Front-to-back airflow for reliable performance
